'''Saralin''' was a [[Da'shain]] [[Aiel]], later [[Jenn Aiel]], who lived during the middle of the [[Breaking of the World]].

{{Ancestry/Rand}}

==History==
Saralin was the mother of [[Lewin]] and [[Maigran]] and the daughter-in-law of [[Adan]]. Her husband was [[Marind]].{{ref/book|twotc|Adan}}

After her son returns from rescuing Maigran from bandits she refuses to acknowledge him and says to hide his face. She does not want to see a face that looks like a son she had on a killer's face.{{ref/book|4|25}}

She lived during the time of the second division of the Da'shain Aiel and the years afterwards where they transitioned to become the Jenn Aiel.
